topic: PUE at the physical floor while Scope 2 climbs — Thirst tease

drafts.text: Google's fleet runs at PUE 1.09. The floor is 1.0 — there's almost nowhere left to sink to. Scope 2 emissions, location-based, still climbed 120.5% since 2019. The efficiency was real. It was never the whole ledger. Thirst tracks what a query costs. Coming to the menu. https://data-snack.com
